note: Datetime Range Timezone extends core datetime_range. Its daterange_timezone field type = DateRangeItem + a timezone varchar(255) column. Widget daterange_timezone adds a Timezone select and re-interprets the entered start/end in that timezone before storage (UTC). Two formatters: daterange_timezone (default; settings separator, format_type, display_timezone) rendered via datetime-range-timezone.html.twig, and daterange_timezone_single_date (settings date_field=start_date|end_date, format_type, display_timezone). Token integration adds start_date/end_date format tokens using the stored timezone. Config schema ids: field.formatter.settings.daterange_timezone(_single_date), field.storage_settings.daterange_timezone. No settings form (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. medium cases inspect a live daterange_timezone field / formatter setting; hard cases create a daterange_timezone field or change a formatter setting, verified against the live field/display config.

evals.prompt: What field type and formatters does the Drupal datetime_range_timezone module provide, and what does it add on top of a normal Datetime Range field?
evals.expected_output: It provides the daterange_timezone field type (extends core DateRangeItem, adding a stored timezone), a daterange_timezone widget with a Timezone select, and two formatters: daterange_timezone (default) and daterange_timezone_single_date. It lets each date range record and display the timezone it was entered in.

evals.prompt: How does datetime_range_timezone store the timezone with a date range, and in what timezone does it display the dates back?
evals.expected_output: The field type adds a 'timezone' varchar(255) column alongside the start/end values. The widget treats the entered dates as being in the selected timezone and core stores the values as UTC; the formatters then render every date using the stored timezone (not the site/viewer timezone).

evals.prompt: Which settings do the datetime_range_timezone formatters expose — for example to hide the timezone label or to render only one endpoint of the range?
evals.expected_output: The default daterange_timezone formatter has separator, format_type, and display_timezone (toggles the timezone label). The daterange_timezone_single_date formatter adds date_field (start_date or end_date) to render just one endpoint, plus format_type and display_timezone.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a field that uses the datetime_range_timezone field type. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_drt_known: its field storage type is daterange_timezone (on node.article).

evals.prompt: The Article field 'field_drt_fmt' on this site is displayed with the datetime_range_timezone single-date formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and state which endpoint of the range it is configured to show (start or end).
evals.expected_output: It shows the end date: the daterange_timezone_single_date formatter on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default has settings.date_field = end_date.

evals.prompt: On this site, add a timezone-aware date range field named field_drt_task to the Article content type using the datetime_range_timezone module's field type, and give it the module's Timezone widget on the default form display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: node.article has field_drt_task whose field storage type is daterange_timezone, and its default form-display widget is daterange_timezone.

evals.prompt: The Article field 'field_drt_disp' is shown with the datetime_range_timezone default formatter, which currently prints the timezone label after the dates. Change the display so the timezone label is NOT shown, and apply it to the live default display.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_drt_disp daterange_timezone formatter has settings.display_timezone set to FALSE (0), hiding the timezone label.
